description: Dead man's switch escrow on Solana devnet (Anchor 0.30): SOL sits in an escrow PDA until a deadline; the owner checks in to extend it, after which the beneficiary may claim. Sol.College runs this lab on its own fork.
demonstrationNotice: Sol.College-owned demonstration on the Blockchains/TrustLock fork. The upstream author (Solana-TrustLock) has not joined Sol.College and there is no partnership; fixes are offered upstream as ordinary pull requests and acceptance here is by Sol.College's own reviewer, not by the upstream project.

scope: Anchor program correctness on the Solana runtime (initialize, deposit, check_in, claim)
QA: localnet fixtures and negative cases
exclusions: Changes to the upstream repository other than ordinary pull requests
Security disclosure in public (security findings go to private channels)

assignments.title: Check In on short test escrows lands after the deadline and fails with DeadlineExceeded; there is no grace or clear UI state
